title: Python ledger: from floats to exact money
prompt: This ledger keeps money in floats, so cents get lost and interest rounds the wrong way. Switch the whole package (ledger/parse.py, ledger/book.py, ledger/fmt.py) to decimal.Decimal as README.md describes, keep the public API the same, fix the fee rule from README.md while you're there, and make sure the tests pass.
